scope: experimental device geometry, contacts, axes, illumination, and interface scenarios required before mesh certification or production optimization

current_code_assumptions.flake: 16 um x 16 um square, 100 nm thick
current_code_assumptions.crystal_mapping: solver x=b, solver y=a, no in-plane rotation
current_code_assumptions.terminals: ideal Dirichlet terminals covering the complete x_min and x_max flake edges
current_code_assumptions.weighting_potential_and_sign: psi=0 at x_min, psi=1 at x_max; positive I is internal conventional current along solver +x from x_min to x_max
current_code_assumptions.au: 8 um x 8 um centered 50 nm binary floating design, in direct thermal/electrical contact with TaIrTe4
current_code_assumptions.illumination: normal-incidence centered 4 um Gaussian, w0=4 um, 285 uW
current_code_assumptions.thermal_outer_boundary: ambient-temperature lateral faces at +/-32 um and substrate bottom at -20 um; top convection 10 W m^-2 K^-1
current_code_assumptions.electrical_void_regularization: finite Au sheet/contact conductivity floors remain in the matrix only; the floor is subtracted from the Au thermopower source so exact void generates zero Au PTE
current_code_assumptions.au_transport: bulk room-temperature scenario: sigma=1/(2.43e-8) S/m, k=317 W/(m K), S_Au=+1.94 uV/K on in-plane Au sheet edges; these are not certified 50 nm film values
current_code_assumptions.au_tairte4_vertical_thermopower: 0 V/K placeholder because no measured interface/out-of-plane thermopower is available; no value is invented

required_user_inputs: flake outline or CAD and TaIrTe4 thickness
a-axis angle in the device coordinate system
measurement-electrode outlines and which contact is the signed output
whether patterned Au is electrically touching TaIrTe4 and is floating or terminal-connected
SiO2 thickness and relevant Si stack
4 um beam power, waist definition, center, incidence, and polarization convention
accepted Au-TaIrTe4 thermal/electrical contact ranges or measurements
measured or accepted 50 nm Au electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, and Seebeck coefficient
measured or accepted vertical Au-TaIrTe4 thermopower model

literature_basis.main_paper: Adv. Funct. Mater. 2026, doi:10.1002/adfm.75986, Eq. (6) and pp. 3-4: collection is geometry-sensitive; transverse example uses a-axis/electrode angle alpha=45 degrees
literature_basis.supplement: adfm75986-sup-0001-suppmat-2.pdf, Sec. S5C-D: collecting electrode psi=1, other electrodes psi=0, sample-air boundaries zero flux
